title: The LLM Landscape — Open Weights and Hosted APIs
key_insight: Open-weight models can run on chosen infrastructure subject to their license. Hosted APIs manage serving but create provider, network, and data-handling dependencies.
body:
## Open Weights and Hosted APIs

One team needs full local control; another needs the strongest service without operating GPUs. The delivery model changes the engineering work.

Open-weight models can run on chosen infrastructure subject to their license. Hosted APIs manage serving but create provider, network, and data-handling dependencies.

Read licenses and data policies directly. “Open” can describe weights, code, or access while permitting different uses.
common_mistakes: One leaderboard winner is best for every application.
A large context window guarantees perfect recall.
Open weights always mean unrestricted use without a license.
mini_exercise: Draw “Open Weights and Hosted APIs” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: Sound model choice begins with the workload and constraints, not a leaderboard winner.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Open Weights and Hosted APIs,” explain The LLM Landscape without assuming the listener knows modern AI.
